name: unbound-demo
description: File-native sales-execution agent for Claude Cowork — demo tier: the complete pro skill set, registered under demo identities (run-unbound-demo, setup-unbound-demo, connect-tools-demo, collect-tasks-demo) so it installs alongside the standard pack rather than replacing it, running fully offline against a bundled fixture corpus, plus the reset-demo workspace bootstrap/reset skill. Every external read resolves to bundled fixture data, so a complete run needs zero connectors, zero credentials and zero network calls. Not a subtractive cut — the same corpus with the demo runtime bindings selected at build time.
